info.name: BotDetector
info.title: Bot detector
info.description: Detects known crawlers and automated HTTP clients by User-Agent for analytics and behavior optimization. Detection is heuristic and must not be used as a security or access-control mechanism.
info.author: Kami team

signatures.title: Automated client signatures
signatures.description: One case-insensitive User-Agent substring per line. Empty lines and lines starting with # are ignored. This list identifies likely automated clients; it must not be used for security decisions.
